Install CourtLoad

Local browser interface

On supported browsers, use Install app or Add to Home Screen in the browser menu. Installation requires a secure origin (HTTPS or localhost); availability depends on your browser.

The icon and app metadata are local assets. Analytical pages, saved evidence, Live and exports require the local API and database. No service worker or offline write synchronization is registered. Browser static-asset caching does not establish current source coverage; analytical fetches use no-store. Inspect Data status for freshness.
